newsitems.title: Demo 0.2.11 Patch Notes
newsitems.author: AntiChromosome
newsitems.contents: New & ImprovedTutorialsAdded tutorial review entries for jewelry design basics, gem setting, purchasing stock, booking visitors by phone, tool processing levels, and separating gems.Added calendar and radio tutorials at the workbench after auctions are unlocked, helping players check auction dates and announcements.The Codex can now be closed with Esc during the introductory tutorial without leaving the tutorial.Ore InformationAdded Attraction to ore details in storage. This stat is highlighted when accessing storage from a display cabinet.The magnifying glass now shows the mineral’s type icon and name.Gem Level, Mineral Type, and Cut Shape requirements in commissions now link to relevant Codex explanations.Books & DocumentsRead books now display “Read” instead of continuing to show a skill point reward.Added read status tracking to several guides and letters that do not award skill points.SettingsMouse sensitivity can now be adjusted more precisely by clicking the number and entering a value directly. The existing reset area outside the number field still works.The resolution list now offers 12 common 16:9 and 16:10 resolutions, including 1920×1200. Changes still require clicking Apply.Several two-option settings now cycle between their options when repeatedly clicking the same arrow.Bug FixesFixed gem separation tutorial progress potentially resetting when switching or retrieving ore. Accumulated progress is now retained, and returning the same gem to storage can count again.Fixed the gem-setting tutorial repeatedly appearing whenever a gem was placed after the tutorial was interrupted or a setting could not be generated. It can now be restarted or skipped through the design tutorial menu.Fixed missing tutorial review entries, incorrect entry links, and overlapping Awareness and Awareness Overload content.Fixed duplicate Select buttons appearing when changing the sorting order of faceting methods.Fixed the upgrade window remaining on screen after leaving a workstation with S.Fixed horizontal and vertical mouse sensitivity affecting the wrong axes.Fixed the VSync setting displaying an incorrect state and failing to toggle off properly.Fixed cursor switching issues when opening the Codex while using a tool.Reading books from the inventory is now temporarily blocked during an ongoing guest conversation at the reception desk, with a reminder to finish the conversation first. This prevents the two conversations from interfering with each other.Adjusted ore connection and separation checks to reduce cases where minerals detach prematurely while still connected to the surrounding rock.Corrected the center position of the paired-wing jewelry component to reduce sideways offset when placing it.ChangesAuctionsReduced the outer auction area’s entry fee from 200 to 0, allowing entry even with no money.Auction invitation visitors now knock in the afternoon, avoiding invitations arriving while players are registering their license before sleep.Updated related task descriptions to direct players to the calendar for auction dates and the radio for announcements on the day.CommissionsNewly generated commissions no longer request balanced or unbalanced jewelry. Existing commissions are unchanged.StorageTemporarily disabled the Alt shortcut for mineral-type icons and removed its input hint.Minerals & AnomaliesAdjusted how some minerals are generated to give newly generated minerals fuller shapes.Adjusted the appearance and disappearance distances of shadow figures and large moths at high Awareness. Distances are now measured from the player’s camera.TextClarified when to register a license: after going to bed, contact the field representative while arranging visitors.Added explanations of gem level versus quality, mineral types, and cut shapes.Notes for Existing SavesSome documents previously did not track whether they had been read. Open their main text again to mark them as read.Existing saves with auctions unlocked may receive the new calendar or radio tutorial once.Auction invitations that have already disappeared from an existing save will not be restored automatically. Auction dates can still be checked on the calendar.

newsitems.title: Abyssal Lapidary Joins Steam Next Fest: Public Demo Now Live!
newsitems.author: AoiSoraXxx
newsitems.contents: Hello, Lapidaries! 💎It’s time to pick your ores, cut your gems, and welcome the first guests to Vermilion House!Abyssal Lapidary is joining this Steam Next Fest, and the public demo is available now! Whether this is your first time here, or you took part in our earlier playtest, we’d love for you to pick up your tools and experience the life of a lapidary, from unearthing raw ore to crafting jewelry and running the shop. We’ve also prepared a new gameplay showcase for this Next Fest.\Trailer Here]Now that you’ve seen the video, you should have a clearer picture of the game. We’ve also put together a FAQ for some of the questions we’ve been hearing the most. 💎 How much content is in this demo? This demo offers 4+ hours of content in a single playthrough, covering roughly 25% of the full game. ✨ What’s changed since the Playtest? This public demo brings performance improvements, new content, and a number of systems that have been adjusted or rebuilt from the ground up. A huge thank you to everyone who joined the playtest and shared their feedback! 🙂 Lower hardware load We’ve significantly reduced CPU and GPU load during gameplay, for a smoother experience. Make your collection part of the workshopThe brand-new display cabinet system is here! You can now exhibit ores, relics, and jewelry in the workshop. These displays don’t just raise your workshop’s appeal, they may also grant special effects. This update also adds a workshop upgrade system, along with a calendar and business log.New tools, new minerals, and new crystal forms Alongside new minerals and crystal forms come brand-new tools, including a head-mounted loupe, explosives, and a wire saw. Existing tools have also been reworked.Crafting and progression updatesGem faceting and jewelry design have been refined.The talent tree has been rebuilt.The license advancement system has been rebuilt.The Perception system has been rebuilt.We’d love for returning friends to come back and try it, and to hear how these changes feel!🖥️ System RequirementsMinimumOS: Windows 10 64-bitProcessor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600Memory: 8 GB RAMGraphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)DirectX: Version 12Storage: 10 GB available spaceRecommendedOS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bitProcessor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600Memory: 16 GB RAMGraphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600DirectX: Version 12Storage: 10 GB available space, SSD recommended📂 About Saves — Please Read Before You Play Saves from the previous Playtest are not compatible with this demo. Players who joined the playtest will need to start a new game. Saves from this demo can be carried over to the full release. *That said, numerical values in the full release may change significantly. Please treat the launch version as the final reference. 🎮 Controller SupportControllers are not supported in this demo. Please play with keyboard and mouse. We plan to add controller support at full launch, or within a few weeks after release.❤️ Thank you for your support, we can’t wait to hear from you! If you run into issues during the demo, or have thoughts about the gameplay, we’d love your feedback. Your experience and suggestions will help us keep polishing the game.You’re also welcome to join the official Discord.And if you have fun with this demo, don’t forget to wishlist Abyssal Lapidary, and share it with friends who love gems, crafting, and management games!May every stone crack open with a surprise, and every day at the workshop bring its reward. See you at Next Fest!——Light Worm

newsitems.title: Abyssal Lapidary Steam Page Is Live: Playtest Sign-Ups Now Open!
newsitems.author: 三天之内我要让这家店倒闭
newsitems.contents: Hello, Lapidary! 💎 We’re excited to finally introduce Abyssal Lapidary to everyone today. Our Steam store page is now officially live, and we’re opening sign-ups for our very first playtest. We’d love for you to join us and help shape the future of the game! What is Abyssal Lapidary? Abyssal Lapidary is a workshop management game centered around ore identification, crafting, and a touch of risk-taking. You inherit Vermilion House, an old jewelry workshop in the underground city of Fathomholm. During each day, you’ll select ores, cut gems, design accessories, and slowly rebuild the workshop through your own judgment and craftsmanship. Every decision matters: Is this ore worth buying? How much waste material should you remove? Which cutting technique will maximize its value? Which customer should receive the finished piece? A single stone might make your fortune, or leave you with nothing. But in Fathomholm, not everything hidden within ore is a gem. Crimson vein pulse beneath certain ores. Customers arrive with symptoms no one can explain. And somewhere deep inside Vermilion House, unsettling sounds echo through the walls... If that sounds interesting, we’d love to invite you to become one of our very first lapidaries! Playtest Information 📅 Playtest Period June 12 – June 22 🎮 Available Content This playtest includes all gameplay content leading up to the Emerald License (the highest license level), offering approximately 3+ hours of playtime. 🔑 How to Participate The test will be conducted through Steam Playtest. Simply visit the Abyssal Lapidary Steam page and click: Request Access We’ll gradually grant access to applicants during the test period. Once approved, Steam will notify you automatically, and you’ll be able to download and play directly from your library. 📝 Feedback Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us. Whether you’ve encountered bugs, balance issues, pacing concerns, UI frustrations, or simply have thoughts about the story, we’d love to hear from you. Feedback Survey: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfY1hyLfBbf9o99bydFSrhErMVQzDcsIhaPgfUJZWZ43ryKqA/viewform?usp=publish-editor 💬 Prefer to chat with us directly? You’re also welcome to join our official Discord. We carefully read every piece of feedback and use it to guide future development. FAQ What are the system requirements? Platform: Windows only Minimum Specifications OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) Processor: Intel Core i5-8400/ AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Memory: 12 GB RAM Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660/ GTX 1660 Super or AMD equivalent Storage: 12 GB available space Which languages are supported? The playtest currently supports: Simplified Chinese Traditional Chinese English Japanese Korean French German Spanish (Spain) Players from all regions are welcome! Please note that some non-Chinese localizations have been assisted by AI during development. As a small indie team, we’re continuously improving localization quality and appreciate your understanding. Abyssal Lapidary is still very much a work in progress, and this playtest is our first opportunity to gather feedback from a wider audience. We’re especially interested in hearing your thoughts on: Ore identification Gem cutting Workshop progression Economic balance Story and mystery elements Overall atmosphere And if you enjoy what you see, consider adding Abyssal Lapidary to your Wishlist—it helps our small team more than you might imagine. ❤️ Thank you for taking a chance on our game. We’ d also love to have you in our Discord. The lights of Vermilion House are burning once again. We’ll see you in Fathomholm. — Light Worm
